The potential difference between two points when one joule of work is done in moving one coulomb of charge from one point to the other — this is called ______.
questions.explanation: Volt: The potential difference between two points when one joule of work is done in moving one coulomb of charge from one point to the other.

questions.prompt: Each plate of an air-filled parallel plate capacitor has an area of 400 cm² and the plates are 0.5 mm apart. Find its capacitance. (ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² F m⁻¹) (Answer in pF, number only): ______
Animals that generate electric shocks is called ______.
questions.explanation: Electrogenic animals: Animals that can naturally generate external electric shocks through internal biological mechanisms that act as batteries.

questions.prompt: The electric potential energy of an object depends on its own electric ______ and its relative position with other charged objects.

questions.explanation: Equivalent capacitance: The capacitance of the single capacitor that behaves in the same way as a whole combination of capacitors.

questions.prompt: The generation or action of electric currents or voltages in biological processes — this is called ______.
